description: Registry of the 6 RM Account-Remediation use cases (Product doc: RM Account-Remediation Dashboard — Use Cases). CaseActionBar.astro/CaseFigure.astro expand this into one action-bar variant and one figure variant per rule_code, so the client detail page always opens with only the smart action and the figure relevant to that row's rule_code — everything else stays reusable across cases.

cases.instructions: Then call `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "client". The tool elicits the draft for review, then asks you to confirm send. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the email was sent (cite `delivery_message` / `message_id`); if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

Then call `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "compliance". The tool elicits the Compliance note (new_status defaults to Escalated), then asks you to confirm send. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the escalation email was sent and that the portfolio row shows Escalated; if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

Then sketch a rebalancing proposal — what to trim, what to redeploy into, and the rough cost and tax impact — that would bring the allocation back within the agreed risk-profile tolerance. Finish by calling `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "client" so the proposal (or discretionary confirmation) goes to the client. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the email was sent (cite `delivery_message` / `message_id`); if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

Then run a short suitability-review questionnaire with me here in chat using what you know about the client, and summarise the answers ready for the file. Finish by calling `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "client" to send the questionnaire / request any missing answers. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the email was sent (cite `delivery_message` / `message_id`); if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

actions.label: 📨 Email client
actions.toast: ✨ Sent to me — drafting the client email
actions.instructions: Then draft the reassessment gap summary, and call `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "client". Review the elicited draft and confirm send. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the email was sent; if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

actions.label: 🚨 Escalate to compliance
actions.toast: ✨ Sent to me — escalating to Compliance
actions.instructions: Then draft why the client cannot qualify, and call `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "compliance". Review the elicited Compliance note (new_status defaults to Escalated) and confirm send. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the escalation email was sent and the portfolio row shows Escalated; if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

cases.instructions: Then draft the reassessment: what changed, why this client is now in scope, and the concrete remediation options — re-categorise, re-paper, ask the client for evidence, or divest. Finish by calling `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "client" (or "compliance" if they cannot qualify). Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the email was sent; if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.

Then draft a Source-of-Wealth corroboration plan for this event, including which supporting documents to request from the client. Finish by calling `send_email` with `pk` {id} and `audience` "client" to request those documents. Afterwards, report the outcome from the tool result: if `sent` is true, tell the RM the email was sent (cite `delivery_message` / `message_id`); if `sent` is false, say clearly that it was not sent and why.
